content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization problem; authorization is not required, and the patient has no contractual cost share to bill. Although an earlier appeal did not resolve the denial, another formal appeal remains permitted and has the strongest applicable historical payment rate: 2/4 versus 3/7 for peer-to-peer review. Appeal the bundling determination using the available documentation to support separate payment rather than resubmitting unchanged claim data.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
